name: Warpwise Desk
user: small weaving studio preparing warp handoffs
input: rough yarn project notes, measured sample references and finished dimensions
bottleneck: linking informal yarn identities and retaining motif, contraction and shared-stock allowances
ai: MiniLM neural reference retrieval; not dimension arithmetic
output: reviewed repeat-aligned warp worksheet and complete audit
distinction: Fiber Balance optimizes recycled-content blends; Cut Ledger partitions linear stock; Succession Bench plans nursery stages. This app computes textile warp contraction, motif repeats, end counts and shared-yarn availability.
